integrity: The finite classification follows from a proved circular-parking transversal lemma and two separately implemented exact-integer censuses, one orbit-reduced and one all-frequency.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite Fourier zero support for classical parking functions only at lengths 1 through 5, not an all-length classification. No complete distribution of nonzero spectral values is claimed.
title: First unexpected Fourier zeros of classical parking-function convolution
